body:
Depends on "Strategy Features tab: read-only list".

- A small title form on each feature. It sends `POST {base}/tasks {title, body:"", request}`, then `PATCH {base}/tasks/{id} {feature}`, reusing `Link`/`Patched`.
- In a workspace, there is a project `<select>` that defaults to the root's project. With a single project there is no picker.
- Errors are reported per step. If the PATCH fails, say the task was created without the link.
- Tests: the POST → PATCH sequence and the case where the PATCH fails, in the JS flow. Update the README.

Pieces 2–4 of the Features tab all edit `features.gleam` and `update`, so run them one after another rather than in parallel.
title: Strategy Features tab: new task for a feature
